newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary Matav prelim. IAS '96 net profit 23-24 bln.
newsitem.headline: Hungary Matav prelim. IAS '96 net profit 23-24 bln.

text.p: Hungarian telecommunications company Matav Rt's chief financial officer said on Wednesday the company expected a net profit of 23 billion to 24 billion forints for 1996 as against 3.9 billion forints in 1995.
Matav expects its operating revenues to reach 194 billion to 195 billion forints in 1996, up from 143 billion in 1995, Ray Stewart told a news conference.
The figures are preliminary and are calculated according to International Accounting Standards, he said.
Matav, Hungary's largest telecommunications company, is 67 percent owned by a 50-50 consortium of Ameritech and Deutsche Telekom, the rest is held by a variety of investors.

Matav is expected to apply for listing on a foreign bourse probably this year, in addition to the Budapest Stock Exchange, but the company has said only that it has chosen Merrill Lynch as adviser for a possible IPO.
